description: Cross-Lingual Dark Science Arbitrage Scout — Finds scientific work that exists only in non-English literature. Give an English topic, a technical bottleneck, or a paper you know (seedPaper: DOI or arXiv id); the scout plans native-terminology searches in up to 6 languages (default zh, ja, de, fr, ko) across OpenAlex, Crossref, HAL, J-STAGE and Europe PMC, drops works that already have an English twin, and returns up to 8 ranked discoveries.

fromDate.description: Earliest publication date. Default: 10 years before the call.

researchTopic.description: English research topic, e.g. "sulfide solid electrolytes for all-solid-state lithium batteries".

seedPaper.description: An English-language paper you already know, as a DOI (bare or doi.org URL) or arXiv id/URL. Its title becomes the research topic (or is added to it) so the scout finds non-English work on the same problem.

targetLanguages.description: ISO 639-1 codes of non-English languages to mine (max 6). Default zh, ja, de, fr, ko.

technicalBottleneck.description: English description of an unsolved technical bottleneck. Provide this, researchTopic or seedPaper (or several).

name: foreignResearchScout
